answer: Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The inlet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The trellis is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the nadir. The design leans on asynchronous consensus epochs backed by multi-party quorum signatures.
